title: feat(studio): the permissions page speaks business wording; bulk buttons show on every row
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBA6p6wR5XRGmnECFZqr87FM)_

Fixes #34795
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio 权限页改用业务说法。默认授予横幅只写一句「所有成员默认拥有这个权限集，新加入的人也会自动拥有。」，按钮改为「取消默认授予」；标题是「应用名 · 权限集显示名」；「记录共享模型(OWD)」改为「谁能看到哪些记录」；页签改为 对象权限 / 系统功能 / 数据范围规则 / 菜单可见；批量按钮「全选 · 只读 · 清空 · 增删改查」每行常显；对象行只显示名称，内部名放在悬停提示里。
- 为什么改：搭应用的人读不懂横幅里的内部名和「Everyone 岗位」，批量按钮要悬停才出现，而且是缩写（卡 #34795，epic #34571）。
- 风险与回滚：只改文案和展示，权限模型、ADR-0090 的建议与确认机制、所有请求都不变。Setup 的权限集页共用几条文案（批量按钮、共享取值、三个分区标题），会一起变，布局不变。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`（`StudioObjectRow` 的批量按钮和固定在右侧的批量列、`renderStudio` 的标题）；`namespaces/studio/zh.ts`（`engine.studio.access.suggest*` 一组文案）；`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`（`AccessPillar` 的左栏行和 `appLabel`）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.accessWording-34795.test.tsx`，预期 12 个测试全部通过；或者用中文界面打开 Studio → 权限，预期每一行都能看到「全选 · 只读 · 清空 · 增删改查」，页面上不出现 OWD、CRUD 或权限集的内部名。
- 需要你做的: 无,席位落地

## What changes

The Studio Access pillar now reads in an app builder's words, in zh-CN and in English. It changes wording and presentation only. The permission model, the ADR-0090 D5/D9 suggestion and confirmation flow, and every request stay the same. ADR-0090 D4 holds: display labels change, stored `sharingModel` values do not.

- **Default-grant banner.** The accepted state is one sentence and no longer names the set or the Everyone position. The button reads 取消默认授予 and calls the same handler as 撤销 did (`dismissSuggestedBinding`). The pending, not-in-force, dismissed, guest, confirm and toast lines use the same tone. Pending rows name the set by its label.
- **Title.** The open set's header is `appLabel · set label`. `AccessPillar` passes the package's name as the new `PermissionStudioChrome.appLabel`. The machine name moves to the title's tooltip, and the provenance, default and lock labels move to the line under the title. The title is not truncated: measured live, `scrollWidth == clientWidth`.
- **Terms.** 记录共享模型(OWD) becomes 谁能看到哪些记录. The values read 只有负责人能看 / 所有人能看 / 所有人都能看和改, and 受父级控制 → {master} becomes 跟随所属的{master}. The tabs read 对象权限 / 系统功能 / 数据范围规则 / 菜单可见.
- **Bulk buttons.** Every row shows 全选 · 只读 · 清空, then the CRUD set as a fourth button (增删改查). Before, the strip appeared only on the row under the pointer or with focus. Each button writes exactly what All / R / None / CRUD wrote before. The footnote that explained the hidden strip is removed, along with its key `engine.studio.access.bulkHint`. The bulk column is pinned to the right edge of the scroll pane, the way the Object column is pinned to the left. Without that, the third and fourth buttons sat past the right edge at 1440 px (live reading below).
- **Object rows.** The matrix and the package's 谁能看到哪些记录 overview show the object's label only. The machine name is the tooltip. The record-visibility chip now stays on one line: the new labels are longer and had wrapped inside its fixed-height box.
- **Rail.** The access rail rows show the set's label, with the machine name as the tooltip, and the hard-coded English `default` tag now uses the localized `perm.badge.default`. The rail's OWD row and the pillar subtitle (`对象 × CRUD`) use the new terms. All of this falls under the card's acceptance line that the page shows no internal name, OWD or CRUD.

### Wording, old → new

| Key | zh-CN old | zh-CN new | en old | en new |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `engine.studio.access.suggestAcceptedState` | 「{set}」已为所有已登录用户(Everyone 岗位)接受。 | 所有成员默认拥有这个权限集，新加入的人也会自动拥有。 | "{set}" was accepted for all signed-in users (Everyone). | Every member has this permission set by default, and new members get it automatically. |
| `engine.studio.access.suggestRevoke` | 撤销 | 取消默认授予 | Revoke | Stop granting by default |
| `engine.studio.settings.sharing` / `access.colOwd` / `owd.railLabel` | 记录共享模型(OWD) / 记录共享模型 / 记录共享（OWD） | 谁能看到哪些记录 | Record sharing (OWD) / OWD | Who can see which records |
| `perm.owd.private` · `public_read` · `public_read_write` | 私有 · 公共只读 · 公共读写 | 只有负责人能看 · 所有人能看 · 所有人都能看和改 | Private · Public read · Public read/write | Only the owner can see · Everyone can see · Everyone can see and edit |
| `engine.studio.owd.byParent` | 受父级控制 → {master} | 跟随所属的{master} | By parent → {master} | Follows its {master} |
| `engine.studio.access.tab.*` | 对象 / 系统能力 / 行级安全 / 标签页可见性 | 对象权限 / 系统功能 / 数据范围规则 / 菜单可见 | Objects / System capabilities / Row-level security / Tab visibility | Object permissions / System features / Record scope rules / Menu visibility |
| `perm.bulk.read` · `perm.bulk.crud` | 读 · 增改删 | 只读 · 增删改查 | R · CRUD | Read only · Read & write |
| `perm.rls.title` · `perm.tabs.title` · `perm.field.systemCapabilities` | 行级安全 · 标签页可见性 · 系统能力 | 数据范围规则 · 菜单可见 · 系统功能 | Row-Level Security · Tab Visibility · System Capabilities | Record Scope Rules · Menu Visibility · System Features |
| `engine.studio.access.subtitle` | 对象 × CRUD · 字段级读写 | 对象权限 · 字段级读写 | — | Object permissions · field-level read/write |
| `preview.changes.securityBlockWhere` (eager packs, all 11) | 请在对象的“设置 → 记录共享模型”中修改后重新发布。 | 请在对象的“设置 → 谁能看到哪些记录”中修改后重新发布。 | Fix it on the object under Settings → Record sharing, then publish again. | Fix it on the object under Settings → Who can see which records, then publish again. |

`perm.bulk.all` / `perm.bulk.none` were already 全选 / 清空 (All / None) and are unchanged. Every changed key is a value edit. Most are in the lazy `studio` namespace (en and zh). One key was removed (`bulkHint`), and none was added. The only eager edit is `securityBlockWhere`, changed in all 11 packs, and the `DraftChangesPanel` default value was changed to match it (seat ruling A, claim amendment on #34795). The new label is translated in the other packs, the same way the old one was.

### Reach: Setup's permission-set page

Setup reads some of the same keys, so it changes too, as the card expects: `perm.bulk.read`/`crud`, `perm.owd.*` values, `perm.rls.title`, `perm.tabs.title` and `perm.field.systemCapabilities`. Setup's layout is unchanged. The Setup-only `perm.owd.chip` / `perm.owd.tip` keys are untouched, so Setup's column chip still reads 记录共享模型：只有负责人能看（默认） in zh and `OWD Only the owner can see (default)` in en. `engine.studio.settings.sharing*` also feeds the Data pillar's object settings panel, which now offers the same four labels.

### i18n budget

`check-eager-closure-budget` (`pnpm --dir ui check:eager-closure`) on a console built from `fafc1d6260`, which carries the hint edit, exited 0. It read: `i18n-locale-en 60.4 KB / 60.5 KB ceiling (headroom 0.2 KB)`, and the whole closure `1896.8 KB gzipped across 103 of 2536 chunks (budget 2431.6 KB)`. The en value grew by 11 bytes raw. The ceiling is not edited.

## Tests

New tests:
- `StudioDesignSurface.accessWording-34795.test.tsx` (12 tests, zh-CN):
  - the accepted sentence and its button;
  - 取消默认授予 calls `dismiss('sug_member')` exactly once, with confirm and reopen never called;
  - a pending row names the label;
  - the title and its tooltip;
  - the tab texts;
  - the visible page text holds no set machine name, `Everyone`, `OWD` or `CRUD`, and the machine name stays reachable as the tooltip;
  - object rows show the label only;
  - the strip renders on every row without hover, in order;
  - one test per button: 全选 = the seven grants that All sets, 只读 = read only, 清空 = none, 增删改查 = the four CRUD columns.
- `PackageOwdOverviewPanel.objectName-34795.test.tsx` (2 tests): the overview row shows the label with the machine name as tooltip, and an unlabelled object shows its name once.

Existing tests updated because they asserted the old wording or the old markup:
- `StudioDesignSurface.accessTabs-12456`: the header tooltip; the always-shown strip replaces the hover tests; the button order.
- `StudioDesignSurface.accessGuard`, `StudioDesignSurface.pillarNavGuard`: the renamed rail row; title lookups.
- `StudioDesignSurface.accessPairCopy-29674`, `accessRailLabels-11862`, `accessCreateTaken-26836`: the rail and header tooltip.
- `ObjectSettingsPanel.test`, `ObjectSettingsPanel.designerRegistryMissing`: the shared sharing labels.
- `PackageOwdOverviewPanel.test`: the shared sharing labels.
- `DirectoryPage.stateVocabulary-29705`: `colOwd` and `perm.owd.private`.
- `PermissionMatrixEditor.columnHeaders-29729`, `.scope`: the Setup chip text with the new value.
- `PermissionMatrixEditor.rlsAddPolicyHold-13113`, `.serverVerdict-26858`, `.serverVerdictHold-27482`, `.packageDoorFacets`: the renamed headings.
- `PermissionMatrixEditor.bulkMergeKeys`, `.exportColumn-26885`, `.artifactTier`, `.readonly`, `.objectGrantInherited-27010`: the bulk labels.
- `PermissionMatrixEditor.gridChrome-27866`: the object button's accessible name is now the label alone.

- `DraftChangesPanel.securityProblems`, `DraftChangesPanel.securityLink`: the refusal hint's new en wording. What they pin is unchanged: the panel names where to fix it.
- `ui/e2e/permission-field-panel-scroll.spec.ts`: the Studio row's expand button is found by its label-only name, `^Project$`. The environment-host lookup still matches label plus name, because the Setup table still prints both. The scroll assertions are unchanged.

18 of these files gained module-top side-effect imports (`@objectstack/lint`, plus `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/spec/identity` in the matrix files), as `check:test-source-alias` requires of an edited test file.

## Acceptance notes

- **Accepted banner, live: NOT MEASURED.** The self-built-app producer of a member-access suggestion lives in the cloud repo, and this session cannot read it (403). Stock `objectstack dev` boots the showcase set as the baseline, so the panel draws nothing. The banner is covered by the zh-CN unit test above.
- The delegated-admin tab's facet pills still show set machine names. That tab is outside this card.
- The explain-access sheet still uses OWD and CRUD in its own strings. It is a closed sheet, opened by its button, and outside this card.
- The list endpoint does not carry `bindingCreated`. A row read back after a not-in-force confirmation therefore shows the in-force sentence. This behaviour is unchanged: only the wording is new.
